title: Can Earlier BCG Vaccination Reduce Early Infant Mortality? A Randomised Trial
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether BCG vaccination shortly after birth can reduce early infant mortality in a rural and an urban setting.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

• All children registered during pregnancy will be eligible for the study provided they have not yet received BCG at the date of the home visit.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Children born outside the cluster, and returning more than 72 hours after the delivery
* Children that the nurse evaluates to die within the next 24 hours.
